title: Pure Virtual World
summary: Pure Virtual World psychic combo deck, utilizing Level 3 and Level 6 EARTH and WIND monsters that Special Summon themselves from the hand by targeting a face-up Virtual World card and milling a different card type. The strategy establishes towering Synchro and Rank 9 Xyz bosses while recurring banished cards via their sacred Gates.

summary.title: Starters
points: Virtual World Mai-Hime - Lulu targets a face-up Virtual World card to send a Virtual World card of a different type from Deck to GY, Special Summons itself as a Level 3 Tuner, and adds a Virtual World card of the third type from Deck to hand.
Virtual World Kirin - Lili targets a Virtual World card to mill a different type, summons itself as a Level 6 non-Tuner, and mills a card of the third type.
Virtual World Roshi - Laolao targets a Virtual World card to mill a different type, summons itself as a Level 6 Tuner, and revives a Virtual World monster with a different name from the GY.
Virtual World Xiezhi - Jiji targets a Virtual World card to mill a different type, summons itself as a Level 3 non-Tuner, and adds a Virtual World monster from GY to hand during the End Phase.
Virtual World City - Kauwloon places a Virtual World Gate directly from your Deck face-up into your Spell & Trap Zone, triggering powerful bonus effects based on how many Gates you control.

summary.title: Opening: Kauwloon + Lulu
steps: Activate Virtual World City - Kauwloon to place Virtual World Gate - Qinglong face-up from your Deck.

Activate Virtual World Mai-Hime - Lulu in hand targeting Qinglong; send Virtual World Gate - Chuche (Trap) to GY, Special Summon Lulu, and add Virtual World Roshi - Laolao (Monster) from Deck to hand.
Activate Virtual World Gate - Chuche in GY, banishing itself to modulate Lulu's Level to 6 (or target Qinglong to negate a monster).
Activate Laolao in hand targeting Qinglong; send Virtual World Gate - Xuanwu (Trap) to GY, Special Summon Laolao, and revive Lulu from GY.
Synchro Summon Level 9 Virtual World Kyubi - Shenshen using Level 6 Laolao and Level 3 Tuner Lulu.
Banish Qinglong from your GY to discard 1 card and add Virtual World Kirin - Lili to your hand for further Rank 6 or Rank 9 plays.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Virtual World Kyubi - Shenshen continuously banishes any card sent from the field to the GY, can banish 2 other monsters with different original Types and Attributes from GY to revive itself, and recycles a banished monster into the GY on attack.

Virtual World Tiger - Fufu is a Rank 9 Xyz that can attack directly while you control 2+ Gates, detaches a material to destroy a card on field, and becomes unaffected by other cards while you control 4 Gates.
Virtual World Phoenix - Fanfan is a Rank 6 Xyz that detaches 2 materials to banish 1 face-up card the opponent controls and 1 card from their GY.

Virtual World Beast - Jiujiu is a Level 6 Synchro that cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects while you have 2+ monsters with the same Type/Attribute in GY, and banishes 2 monsters from GY to send a card on field to GY.
Virtual World Dragon - Longlong is a Rank 3 Xyz that negates monster effects of Attributes the opponent does not control.

summary.title: The Sacred Gates
points: Virtual World Gate - Qinglong negates the effects of a face-up monster on the field, and banishes itself from GY to search any Virtual World monster and discard 1 card.

Virtual World Gate - Chuche shuffles 2 banished Virtual World cards with different names into the Deck to target and destroy 1 face-up card on the field as a Quick Effect, and banishes itself from GY to increase or decrease a Virtual World monster's Level/Rank by 3.
Virtual World Gate - Xuanwu banishes itself from the GY to Special Summon a Virtual World monster from your GY, then sends 1 card from your hand to the GY.
